name: @tradew/types
description: Shared TypeScript domain types & contracts — entitlements/subscriptions, market data provider abstraction, API DTOs

scripts.//prepare: Runs automatically on `npm ci`/`npm install` at the root. This package is consumed by its `types: dist/index.d.ts` entry, not its source, and dist/ is gitignored — so on a clean checkout every consumer (all three CI jobs, and any fresh clone) failed with TS2307 'Cannot find module @tradew/types' until something built it. Nothing did. A prepare hook is the fix that works everywhere rather than one build step per CI job.
